name: mirofish
description: MiroFish - 简洁通用的群体智能引擎，预测万物

scripts.setup: npm install && cd frontend && npm install
scripts.setup:all: npm run setup && npm run setup:backend
scripts.backend: cd backend && uv run python run.py
scripts.desktop:build:full: npm run desktop:stage:full && npm --prefix desktop run build:full
scripts.desktop:build: npm --prefix desktop run build:panel && npm run desktop:stage:full && npm --prefix desktop run build:full
